Name: Loveland Farm Expanded Configurations
Author: OneLeggedMan
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5][center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/svxqag]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cQaeSuH.png[/img]
[/url][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/svxqag?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=share_collection][b][/b][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/svxqag][b]Loveland Farm Expanded[/b][/url]﻿ [/font]﻿﻿[/center][/size][/b][b][size=5][line][/size][/b][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5][left]
What Is This[/left][/size][/b][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]This is the configuration setup for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/svxqag?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=share_collection][b]Loveland Farm Expanded[/b][/url] collection. I made these edits originally for my girlfriend and I, just to bring our own vision of Stardew Valley to life—something cozy, a little witchy, and multiplayer-friendly.[/font][font=Comic Sans MS]

This config isn’t about performance or optimization. It’s simply a collection of settings that I went through—[b]turning things on or off, or adjusting values the mod creators already gave us the option to change[/b]. Nothing fancy, just making sure it all worked well together with the rest of the mods we were using.
[/font][line][font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5]
Not a Standalone Mod[/size][/b]

This isn’t something to install by itself. It’s included with the collection and gets applied automatically through Vortex. If you’re seeing this page outside the collection context, it’s not meant to be used on its own.
[/font][line][font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5]
Why This Exists[/size][/b]

A lot of mods in the collection come with optional settings—stuff like UI choices, NPC schedules, lighting tweaks, shop availability, and other gameplay details. If you’re playing solo, you can mess with those however you want.
But in multiplayer? If one person has different configs than another, things break. Events won’t trigger right, inventories won’t match, and sometimes the game just doesn’t behave the way it should.
This config helps avoid all that by making sure [b]everyone’s using the same settings[/b].
[/font][line][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b][size=5]What I Actually Did[/size][/b]

To be clear—[b]I didn’t make any of these mods[/b] or create the config systems. All I did was go through the available options the mod authors provided and tweak them where it made sense:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Disabled a few default settings where they conflicted with other mods[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Turned on features that fit the vibe we wanted[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Edited values to make things line up across the collection[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]It’s not some deep technical overhaul—just a way to make all the pieces work well together for how we wanted to play.
[/font][line][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b][size=5]Summary[/size][/b]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Made for the [b]Loveland Farm Expanded[/b] collection[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Applies automatically through Vortex[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Helps prevent multiplayer issues like desync or broken events[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Not meant for individual installation[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]All credit goes to the mod creators—I just worked within the options they gave[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font]
